symptom: One of Tracks Does Not Run
detail_of_failure: The track does not move. (Only on one side).
related_information: Pre-troubleshooting If a failure code is shown, do the troubleshooting for that code first. Monitoring code • Travel PPC pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 01882) • F pump pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 01100) • R pump pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 01101)

steps.procedure: 1. Open the Front Pump Pressure screen. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “How to Examine Monitoring Information” of “Service Mode”. 2. Start the engine. 3. Operate each travel lever to do the troubleshooting. 4. Does the measurement result agree with the standard value? branches.YES: Go to the check item of right travel control valve.
branches.NO: • If the front pump pressure is low, go to the check item of suction valve of right travel control valve. • If the rear pump pressure is low, go to the check item of suction valve of left travel control valve.

steps.procedure: 1. Release the pressure that remains in the hydraulic tank and piping to do the troubleshooting. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Release Remained Pressure in Hydraulic Circuit”. 2. Examine the control valve body and the travel spool to see if they are not twisted or stuck. (They must move smoothly and not be stuck.) Are they clean? REMARK Be careful that dirt does not enter during recovery work.

branches.YES: • The body and spool of R.H. travel operation valve is normal. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • The body and spool of R.H. travel operation valve is defective. • Replace the body and spool of the right travel control valve. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.cause: Suction valve of R.H. travel control valve
steps.procedure: 1. Release the pressure that remains in the hydraulic tank and piping. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Release Remained Pressure in Hydraulic Circuit”. 2. Examine the suction valve of the right travel control valve. 3. Is the suction valve on the R.H. travel control valve normal?

branches.YES: • The suction valve of the right travel control valve is normal. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • The suction valve of the right travel control valve is defective. • Replace the suction valve of the right travel control valve. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.cause: Safety valve of R.H. travel motor
steps.procedure: 1. Do the troubleshooting. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Examine and Adjust Oil Pressure in Work Equipment, Swing, and Travel Circuits”. • If any abnormality is found in troubleshooting result, proceed to next troubleshooting. • If no abnormality is found in troubleshooting result, proceed to next check item. 2. Interchange the safety valves of the right and left travel motors. 3. Is there no change, and does the phenomenon reproduce? branches.NO: • Safety valve of L.H. travel motor is defective. • Replace the safety valve of L.H. travel motor. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.cause: Check valve of R.H. travel motor
steps.procedure: 1. Interchange the check valves between the forward and reverse sides of the same travel motor. 2. Is there no change, and does the phenomenon reproduce?

branches.YES: • Check valve of the R.H. travel motor is normal. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • Check valve of the R.H. travel motor is defective. • Replace the check valve of the right travel motor. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.cause: Check valve of the L.H. travel motor
steps.procedure: 1. Interchange the check valves between the forward and reverse sides of the same travel motor. 2. Is there no change, and does the phenomenon reproduce?

branches.YES: • Check valve of the L.H. travel motor is normal. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • Check valve of the L.H. travel motor is defective. • Replace the check valve of the left travel motor. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Idle run the right track off the ground while the brake is applied to do the troubleshooting. 2. Is the right track stopped?

branches.YES: • R.H. travel motor parking brake is normal. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • R.H. travel motor parking brake is defective. • Replace the parking brake of the right travel motor. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Idle run the left track off the ground while the brake is applied to do the troubleshooting. 2. Is the left track stopped?

branches.YES: • L.H. travel motor parking brake is normal. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • L.H. travel motor parking brake is defective. • Replace the parking brake of the left travel motor. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: Is the final drive clean, with no unusual noise, abnormal heat, or metal powder in the drain oil?

branches.YES: • The final drive is correct. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • The final drive is defective. • Replace the final drive. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Stop the engine. 2. Connect all the component parts. 3. Start the engine to do the troubleshooting. 4. Does the machine travel normally?

branches.NO: Return to the first check item.
